item.title: Asking Eric: There have been three of us in this marriage
item.description: Dear Eric: I have been with my husband for almost 35 years. We both had been married and divorced once. But there have been three of us in this marriage: my husband, myself and his mother. She has always treated me poorly and he always defends her.
